lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance circular spots are arranged in multiple horizontal rows extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, forming a semi-regular 2D grid with roughly uniform spacing between centroids in the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating grid-like anchor nodes where the high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersection points of the vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges run across the visible flank; the median ridge is most prominent, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 16-20 high-luminance blobs; larger, higher-intensity spots are clustered near the anterior base, with smaller, lower-intensity spots distributed towards the apex and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several small notches and irregular contouring are visible on the distal trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral-lateral flank, posterior to the insertion of the right pectoral fin.
